create_EgoTaskQA_dataset: create an EgoTaskQA dataset instance with video params, data directory, and split configuration
load_metadata_EgoTaskQA: load EgoTaskQA metadata from JSON split files and subsample into a pandas DataFrame
get_video_frames: get video frames from an MP4 file with configurable frame count and transform pipeline
collate_batch: collate a batch of EgoTaskQA samples into stacked tensors with tokenized text and reasoning indices
get_video_path: get the full video file path by joining the data directory with the sample interval
